format: Silent full-product walkthrough, 6-8 minutes, plus standalone chapters
gate: User reviews the edited 20.68-second pilot before full production
provider_access: Local render and Studio working; no hosted account or upload required
geometry_creation_limit: The pilot creates a procedural House preset, not an AI-generated 3D model. Sketch image generation does not automatically produce a matching editable 3D building. Full demo must distinguish these workflows.

chapters.title: Explore a world
features: Enter a street from a map
limits: Generated interiors are not traversable 3D interiors
Minimap pointer overlap needs preflight

chapters.title: Direct the view
limits: Image camera requests are not guaranteed calibrated renders
Do not imply a free camera-height slider that is not exposed

chapters.title: Expand and connect
limits: Outward identity remains experimental
Outpainting is image-plane expansion, not physical travel

chapters.title: Review and keep image edits
limits: Zero outside-mask pixel changes does not establish semantic correctness

chapters.title: Additional image workflows
limits: Existing mocked tests are not live visual proof
Alternate views must retain geometry-unverified labeling

chapters.title: Draw and change geometry
limits: Authored geometry, not automatic image reconstruction
Generic material color persists but street textures override its visible effect; pilot uses roof material instead

chapters.title: Inspect and move in 3D
features: Guided approach on its supported template
limits: Walk eye height is fixed at 1.6 authored metres
No continuous route between independent local scenes

chapters.title: Connect geometry and map artwork
limits: Street and interior images do not automatically repaint
Do not conflate the added workshop with a separately imagined interior

chapters.title: Keep world knowledge
limits: Use only synthetic notebook content; never expose private creator notes

chapters.title: Import, export, and share
limits: No public publication without approval
No confidential assets in hosted demo uploads

chapters.title: Quality and motion controls
limits: Do not generate paid animations during the zero-spend pilot
Judge acceptance is not a guarantee of visual correctness
Feature flag availability must be checked before full recording
